purpose: Stage 0.5 item 5, A_static round: on the same new near-bucket instances, the engineering column (fixed G0 chain, colour-rule locate) and the Agent column (the brain calls the G0 nodes at P3, harness/agent_column.py agent-column-p3-g0-20261117; no recovery, no growth) under the series kernel K_v2 and hand rule v2, paired per instance. Gives the Agent-column pi_j / p_j baseline, the difference between the brain calling G0 and the fixed chain, and the engineering baseline under K_v2 + v2. User decision 2026-11-17: this paired run replaces item 3's same-seed rerun.
replaces: experiments/grow_up_harness_v2/configs/tabletop_kernel_near_20261117_001.json (item 3, registered, never prepared); its check of decision equivalence with the stage-0 K_v1 episodes is not done
instance_note: New seeds. exclude_cells drops the train cells of the y=0.25 row (design §5.1, stage-0 preflight 1/7 there); ids and train/test partitions are those of the full grid, so test cells (near_0_0, near_1_2, near_2_1) stay held out. 4 train cells remain. Rejected samples stay as not-ready rows; nothing is resampled.

baselines.negative: 2 s wait on the first ready instance of each template under hand rule v2; any goal satisfaction invalidates the whole batch
baselines.engineering: fixed G0 tool chain under K_v2, colour-rule locate, no model call (G0 never passes a query)
baselines.agent: brain picks each next G0 node or stops; may choose the K3 primitive for locate (kernel-provided, reported separately); configuration and hand_open before its first decision; at most 8 decisions
baselines.comparison: stage-0 near batch (outputs/tabletop_kernel_near_20261113_001, K_v1) on other seeds; not paired

caps_note: Episode caps as in the agent checkpoint check (two VLM calls of 20-50 s possible, up to 8 brain calls under a 180 s gateway timeout). A wall alarm during a brain call surfaces as GatewayUnavailable and voids the batch as a system failure.
budget_note: 3 negatives + 18 instances x 2 arms = 39 if all are ready; rejected instances run no episode.
prediction: No system failure, no KERNEL_CHANGED_AFTER_PREPARE, negatives 3/3 not satisfied.

Decision equivalence: on every instance where the agent executes exactly the engineering column's tools with every locate by the colour rule (report pairs: equivalent), the physical records are equal (physics_equal: integration and boundary states, actions.json, tools.json): brain calls step no physics. result.error and execution.json differ by design there, since the brain stops instead of an exception ending the chain.

The brain starts locate with the colour rule and, after a colour-rule PerceptionError, retries with the K3 primitive (as in both checkpoint-check sources); so the agent's locate boundary passes on at least as many instances as the engineering column's.

Grasp stays the frontier in both columns (stage 0: 0/14 HeldLifted grasp boundaries under v1, 2 flips under v2): at most 3 full successes per column over the 18 instances. No prediction on which column has more.
At most 1 AgentSchemaError over the agent episodes; every agent episode ends with stop (done or give_up) or a node-terminating guard, not BRAIN_CALL_BUDGET.
falsification: Negative control satisfies a goal, or any system failure: the whole batch is invalid.
A pair with equivalent true and physics_equal false: the Agent column carries hidden state or nondeterminism; its results are not used as a baseline (item 6) until the cause is found.
An agent locate that reports success while its boundary truth fails with the K3 primitive: the lift is not reliable on new seeds; K3 use in the agent column is reported as a kernel gap.
More than 1 AgentSchemaError or any BRAIN_CALL_BUDGET: the prompt or decision schema is not usable for item 6 as is; reported, not fixed inside this run.
